title: Google Ads for Hair Salons - Ultimate 2025 Guide to Boost Bookings and Revenue

facts.fact: The page suggests a small hair salon spend about ₹10,000–₹20,000 per month on Google Ads.
The page suggests a mid-size hair salon spend about ₹20,000–₹50,000 on Google Ads (period not stated).
The page suggests a high-end hair salon spend ₹50,000 or more on Google Ads (period not stated).
The page recommends setting an ad radius of about 5 to 10 km around the salon so only nearby people see the ad.
facts.quote: Set a **radius** around your salon — like 5 to 10 km — so only people nearby see your ad.

facts.fact: The page describes YouTube video ads for salons as short videos of 15–30 seconds.
facts.quote: Short 15–30 sec videos showing hair transformations

facts.fact: The page states that Local Service Ads (Google Guaranteed) appear above search ads.
facts.quote: These appear **above** search ads and help salons build trust immediately with a Google-backed badge.
